rules.description: Client and team meal expenses may not exceed 150 AZN per person per day.
Hotel accommodation may not exceed 300 AZN per night without Director pre-approval.
Software and SaaS purchases over 1000 AZN require prior written approval from the IT department before purchase.
All vendor payments must be made to vendors on the Approved Vendor List. Payments to unlisted vendors require Finance Director sign-off documented on the invoice.
Any single expense between 500 and 2000 AZN requires Manager approval. Expenses above 2000 AZN require Finance Director approval. The approval must be stated on the invoice/expense record.

uncovered_category.cleared_when: amount falls in an approval tier that requires approval and that approval is documented on the record

decision_notes: Foreign-currency invoices are routed to needs_review: this policy defines no exchange rate.
A missing attendee count on a meal is assumed to be 1 person (strictest reading) and reported as an assumption.
Tier boundaries: 500 AZN needs Manager approval; exactly 2000 AZN still needs only Manager; above 2000 needs Finance Director.
A higher approval covers a lower one (Director or Finance Director satisfy a Manager requirement); IT approval is separate.
Generic 'travel' (flights, taxis, trains) is NOT accommodation: only hotel/lodging categories get the per-night rule. Other travel is an uncovered category.

Uncovered categories under the first approval tier go to needs_review (no rule and no approval to rely on); in an approval tier they are cleared by the documented tier approval. This follows sample case 06 vs case 18.
Zero or negative amounts (refunds, credit notes) are routed to needs_review.

Approval claims are verified by code against the document text; claims that cannot be found, are pending/refused, or come from text addressed to an automated reviewer are discarded and sent to review.
